titlebar.welcome_sub: Press your hotkey anytime to open the module menu.
titlebar.run_on_startup_desc: Start automatically in the background when Windows boots.
titlebar.auto_updates_desc: Check for updates every time the app launches.
titlebar.hotkey_desc: Press a combination to open the quick action menu anywhere.
titlebar.language_desc: Interface language. Applies instantly to every screen.
updater.checking_sub: Establishing a secure connection to the BurnedWolf network…
updater.available_sub: An updated build is ready. Installing only takes a few seconds and your settings will be preserved.
updater.installing_sub: Please don't close the window — this only takes a moment.
updater.uptodate_sub: BurnedWolf is up to date. Redirecting to the main interface…
updater.error_sub: Check your internet connection and try again. If your DNS was left broken by a crash, the repair button below usually fixes it.
exit.title: Terminating Session
exit.sub: Closing secure tunnels and clearing network hooks…
exit.footer: It's safe to close — all background processes will be terminated.
onboard.lang_sub: Pick the language you want BurnedWolf to use. You can change it later in settings.
onboard.update_sub: Should BurnedWolf check for updates automatically on every launch? You can change this later in settings.
onboard.update_yes_desc: Recommended. Always run the latest features and security fixes.
onboard.update_no_desc: Skip the update check at startup. You can still update manually anytime.
onboard.footer: Welcome to BurnedWolf · Setting things up
spotlight.empty: No modules found matching your query.
spotlight.module_dpi_desc: Open the DPI shield control panel.
spotlight.module_verify_desc: Open file verification and repair tool.
spotlight.warning_banner: Your game might be running in exclusive fullscreen mode. Switch to 'Borderless Windowed' for seamless overlay.
dpi.isp_hint_default: Recommended profiles are marked with ★ in the dropdown.
dpi.isp_hint_unknown: Public IP lookup failed. Pick a profile manually from the dropdown.
dpi.failover_hint: Rotate to next recommended profile if Discord becomes unreachable.
dpi.failover_hint_disabled: Needs a known ISP with multiple recommended profiles.
dpi.terminal_ready: BurnedWolf shield module ready. Awaiting command.
dpi.whitelist_desc: Hostlist-Auto is active. Shield will only trigger on specified or automatically detected blocked domains.
dpi.tr_master_desc: Bundled list of Turkey-blocked / throttled domains (Discord, Roblox, YouTube, X, Mega, Twitch, Reddit, VPN sites). Applied as a second hostlist alongside your own — DPI bypass only triggers on these targets, leaving the rest of the web full-speed.
dpi.analysis_desc: Tests every profile against Discord, YouTube, X, Roblox, and Twitch — both HTTP/HTTPS and voice UDP. Synthesizes a custom mutation if no built-in profile passes (Deep mode only).
dpi.analysis_terminal_ready: System ready for analysis. Pick a scan mode above.
dns.ttnet_warning_desc: Türk Telekom intercepts DNS queries on port 53. Without Encrypted DNS, the DPI bypass cannot reach the correct servers.
dns.modal_desc: BurnedWolf will set this DNS on your active network adapter. You can revert to automatic at any time.
dns.doh_option: Use Encrypted DNS (DoH) — recommended for ISPs that hijack port 53
dns.dns_revert_failed: Could not revert DNS — please reset network adapter manually
dns.encrypted_start_failed: Encrypted DNS could not start (dnscrypt-proxy missing or port 53 in use)
verify.title: System Integrity Check
verify.desc: Verifies your local installation against the original server files and repairs any missing or corrupt components automatically.
verify.repaired_count: System firewall renewed. A total of {n} files were repaired.
verify.integrity_ok: Integrity verified at 100%. All files are original and no intervention was required.
home.stopped_sub: Select a profile and press Start
dns.head: DNS & encryption
dns.encrypted_desc: Runs dnscrypt-proxy locally and routes DNS over HTTPS. Best against ISP DNS hijacking.
dns.providers: Or pick a plain DNS provider
analysis.head: Network analysis
analysis.desc: Tests profiles against Discord, YouTube, X, Roblox and Twitch, then applies the best one as a Custom profile.
adv.head: Advanced
adv.failover_desc: Rotate through recommended profiles if Discord becomes unreachable.
adv.failover_unavailable: Needs a known ISP with multiple recommended profiles. Detection inconclusive — disabled.
adv.failover_ready: Rotate through {n} profiles if Discord becomes unreachable.
adv.trmaster_count: {n} domains bundled (Discord, Roblox, YouTube, X, Mega, Twitch, …).
adv.whitelist_desc: One domain per line. These get DPI bypass treatment.
settings.update_notes_desc: Show the changelog popup when the app opens.
settings.check_updates_desc: Look for a newer version right now.
settings.backup_desc: Export your settings and whitelist to a file, or import them back.
notes.title: What's new
builder.adv_desc: Build, clone, import and share your own DPI profiles.
builder.title: Profile builder
builder.name: Profile name
builder.quick_add_desc: Click to append a flag. Use “new chain” to start a separate filter block.
proxy.adv_desc: Share Tor with other apps as SOCKS/HTTP, or a PAC file.
proxy.title: Proxy bridge
proxy.intro: Route other apps through Tor — point them at one of these endpoints.
proxy.tor_off: Not running — start it to use the bridge
proxy.socks_desc: Best for browsers and SOCKS-aware apps. DNS resolves through Tor.
proxy.http_desc: For apps that only accept an HTTP proxy. Tunnels through Tor.
proxy.pac_desc: Point Windows or your browser’s automatic proxy config at this file.
bridges.adv_desc: Pluggable transports (obfs4 / snowflake) for when Tor is blocked.
bridges.title: Tor bridges
bridges.intro: Use pluggable transports when Tor itself is blocked. Needs the transport binary in the app’s tor-bin folder.
bridges.enable_desc: Route Tor through a pluggable transport.
bridges.lines_desc: One per line, from bridges.torproject.org or Tor Browser. Snowflake needs its one bridge line too.
bridges.help_body: Copy obfs4proxy.exe (or lyrebird.exe) and snowflake-client.exe from Tor Browser’s PluggableTransports folder into this app’s tor-bin folder.
stats.title: Statistics
home.health_idle: Starts measuring once protection is on
home.health_wait: First measurement in a few seconds
dns.hero_desc: Every site you visit starts with a DNS question. Turkish ISPs hijack port 53 to answer it themselves — encrypted DNS hides the question inside HTTPS so they can't.
dnsfix.check_sub: Making sure an interrupted encrypted-DNS session didn't leave your resolver stranded on 127.0.0.1.
dnsfix.title: Repair DoH residue
dnsfix.desc: If a crash or power cut left DNS pointing at 127.0.0.1 with nothing listening, this puts it back so the internet works again.
dnsfix.banner_text: Encrypted DNS didn't shut down cleanly, so nothing is resolving names. One click fixes it.
dnsfix.broken_sub: Your network adapter still resolves through 127.0.0.1 but nothing is listening there, so nothing will load. Repair it and BurnedWolf will carry on.
dnsfix.fixed_text: Your adapter was pointing at a dead local resolver. It's back to normal — continuing.
dnsfix.fixed_text_named: Repaired on: {a}. Your connection is back to normal.
dnsfix.none_text: Your DNS is configured correctly — no leftovers from encrypted DNS.
dnsfix.failed_text: Windows refused the change. Try again, or set your adapter's DNS to Automatic (DHCP) in network settings.
analysis.empty_desc: Run an analysis and every profile gets tested against real sites. The winner is applied automatically.
verify.empty_desc: Every bundled file is compared against the original. Anything missing or altered is downloaded again.
home.log_empty_desc: Engine, DNS and Tor events appear here as they happen.
dnsfix.banner_text_partial: One adapter still resolves through 127.0.0.1 with nothing listening there. Other connections are covering for it, so some apps work and others fail. One click clears it.
home.err_sub: The engine could not start. Try another profile or run Analysis.
